title: ACTREC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 06 Nurse Posts
description: The Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 06 nurse positions. Candidates who have qualified in GNM, M.Sc Nursing, and B.Sc Nursing can grab this chance and apply for the ACTREC Notification 2026 .
